head: Somebody warn the Kraken’s goalie
paras: The Kraken have won both meetings this season. The Kraken come in at 8-4-1, the Flames at 5-7-0.
At home, Ryan Huska likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Kraken’s first line. Don’t read much into Wolf’s record against the Kraken.

items.text: The Flames are newly without Devin Cooley, and have been without Samuel Honzek, Maxim Tsyplakov, Joel Hanley and Connor Zary for several games. Dustin Wolf is expected to start.
The Kraken are newly without Jared McCann.
Chandler Stephenson has a point in six straight games against Calgary.
Brandon Montour is two goals from 100.

CGY.head: A slightly uphill night for the Flames
CGY.body: The two have been about even at out-chancing opponents lately. Seattle will be without McCann, while Calgary has home-ice advantage. The Flames can tip it if they keep the shots coming.

SEA.head: The Kraken start a half-step ahead
SEA.body: The two have been about even at out-chancing opponents lately. Seattle will be without McCann, while Calgary has home-ice advantage. Still, it’s close: the Flames can make it interesting if they keep the shots coming.

calls.head: The Flames want Coronato head to head with Eberle
calls.body: At home, the Flames keep sending Coronato’s line (Farabee, Backlund and Coronato) out against opponents’ first lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Ryan Huska has been choosing strength on strength. Tonight the Kraken’s first line is McMann, Beniers and Eberle.

calls.head: The Kraken don’t own Wolf
calls.body: Wolf has been shaky against the Kraken since 2023-24, well below his usual. But three seasons of data say a goalie’s record against one team tells us nothing about the next meeting, so don’t be surprised if he looks like himself tonight.

calls.head: Somebody warn the Kraken’s goalie
calls.body: The Flames love to shoot, and the Kraken keep letting teams do it. Get ready for a shooting gallery.

calls.head: Nobody’s sitting back in this one
calls.body: The Kraken play some of the league’s fastest games, and so do the Flames. We think this one runs hotter than either team’s usual.
